sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Heart, Male v1.3

sources.used: 19 of 87 vessel meshes (aortic root and arch with branch stumps, pulmonary trunk/arteries/veins, venae cavae, coronary arteries and sinus)

files.attribution: Heart and great vessels: "3D Reference Organ for Heart, Male v1.3" (https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM564.WKNG.249) and "3D Reference Organ for Blood Vasculature, Male v1.3" by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein, Human Reference Atlas / NIH HuBMAP, made from the Visible Human Male (National Library of Medicine); licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified by Bilig: subset of vessels, renamed parts, simplified, recoloured, schematic pericardium added.
modifications: kept the 14 heart meshes and 19 great-vessel meshes around the heart from the vasculature model (same Visible Human Male frame, no fitting)

renamed nodes to the topic concept masks: RightAtrium, LeftAtrium, RightVentricle, LeftVentricle, Valve_{Tricuspid,Mitral,Aortic,Pulmonary}, Aorta_* (ascending, arch, descending, branch stumps); papillary muscles became children of their ventricle; septum, pulmonary vessels, venae cavae and coronaries are named but not bound to a concept
added a schematic pericardium (PCA-fitted ellipsoid around the chambers; not in the source) as the isContainer shell
baked node transforms, centred on the chambers and scaled ×27.37 (metres → scene units, heart ≈ 3.4 units)
replaced materials with flat per-tissue colours (arteries red, pulmonary arteries and veins of the body blue)
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, meshoptimizer simplify (ratio 0.35, error 0.0008), EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation
